title: Finite presentation stage of a closed-fibre finite étale cover
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $B=\widehat A$ its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $p:B\to A/I$ the canonical projection. Let $f:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $Y_0=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $V\to Y_0$ be finite étale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. There exist a finitely presented commutative $A$-algebra $R$ (a quotient of $A[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ by a finitely generated ideal), an $A$-algebra map $c:R\to B$, a finite étale cover $W\to Y_R=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $k:Y_0\to Y_R$ such that its $Y$ projection is $Y_0\to Y$, its $R$ projection is $Y_0\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}(p\circ c)}\operatorname{Spec}R$, and $W\times_{Y_R,k}Y_0\cong V$ as $Y_0$-schemes. Neither henselianity nor the G-ring condition is required.

proof.text: Completion. Since $A$ is Noetherian, $I$ is finitely generated. Let $A^\wedge$ be the $I$-adic completion of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $\iota:A\to A^\wedge$, and $\pi^\wedge:A^\wedge\to A/I$ the projection. By [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-ideal], $A^\wedge$ is $IA^\wedge$-adically complete and $\pi^\wedge$ induces an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $A^\wedge/IA^\wedge\cong A/I$ with $\pi^\wedge\circ\iota$ the quotient map $\pi:A\to A/I$. By [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian], $A^\wedge$ is Noetherian. Put $Y^\wedge=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$; it is proper over $\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$ [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change]. Its closed fibre is $Y^\wedge_0=Y^\wedge\times_{A^\wedge}\operatorname{Spec}(A^\wedge/IA^\wedge)=Y\times_A\operatorname{Spec}(A^\wedge/IA^\wedge)$ (transitivity of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]), and the $A$-algebra isomorphism $A^\wedge/IA^\wedge\cong A/I$ gives an isomorphism $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$ over $Y$.

proof.text: Complete case. Via $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$ regard $V$ as a finite etale $Y^\wedge_0$-scheme. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-lifting-complete] applied to the Noetherian $IA^\wedge$-adically complete pair $(A^\wedge,IA^\wedge)$ and the proper $Y^\wedge\to\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$ (step 1), there are a finite etale $W^\wedge\to Y^\wedge$ and an isomorphism $W^\wedge\times_{Y^\wedge}Y^\wedge_0\cong V$ over $Y^\wedge_0\cong Y_0$.

proof.text: $A^\wedge$ as a limit of finite type $A$-algebras. For a finite subset $F\subseteq A^\wedge$ let $A_F\subseteq A^\wedge$ be the $A$-subalgebra generated by $F$; the $F$ are directed by inclusion, $A_F\subseteq A_{F'}$ for $F\subseteq F'$, and every element of $A^\wedge$ lies in some $A_F$, so $A^\wedge=\varinjlim_FA_F$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] with the inclusions $\iota_F:A_F\to A^\wedge$. Each $A_F$ is of finite type over the Noetherian ring $A$, hence of finite presentation (Hilbert basis theorem; Mathlib Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType). Hence $\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge=\varprojlim_F\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ with affine transition morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit]. Put $Y_F=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A_F=Y_\emptyset\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A_\emptyset}\operatorname{Spec}A_F$; then $Y^\wedge=\varprojlim_FY_F$ with affine transition morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-over-limit] (applied to $T=Y_\emptyset\to\operatorname{Spec}A_\emptyset$). Each $Y_F\to\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ is proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], hence quasi-compact and separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], so $Y_F$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ being affine.

proof.text: Descent of the cover to a finite stage. $W^\wedge\to Y^\wedge$ is finite, hence affine, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and etale, hence locally of finite presentation [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]; so it is of finite presentation. By [thm-pd-spreading-out] (1), applied to the system $(Y_F)$ of step 3, there are $F_0$ and a morphism of finite presentation $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ with $W_{F_0}\times_{Y_{F_0}}Y^\wedge\cong W^\wedge$ over $Y^\wedge$; $W_{F_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, being of finite presentation over the qcqs $Y_{F_0}$. For $F\supseteq F_0$ let $W_F=W_{F_0}\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A_{F_0}}\operatorname{Spec}A_F$, so $W_F\to Y_F$ is the base change of $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ to the stage $\operatorname{Spec}A_F$ of the system $(\operatorname{Spec}A_F)_{F\supseteq F_0}$ (limit $\operatorname{Spec}A^\wedge$) and its base change to the limit is $W^\wedge\to Y^\wedge$, which is finite and etale. By [lem-weil-pbc-descend-finite] (with $W_{F_0}\to Y_{F_0}$ locally of finite type) and [lem-weil-pbc-descend-etale] (with it locally of finite presentation) there are $F_1,F_2\supseteq F_0$ with $W_{F_1}\to Y_{F_1}$ finite and $W_{F_2}\to Y_{F_2}$ etale; for $F=F_1\cup F_2$, $W_F\to Y_F$ is a base change of both, hence finite and etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and $W_F\times_{Y_F}Y^\wedge\cong W^\wedge$.

After increasing i we may assume that U_i -> X_{A_i} is finite and etale (Limits, Lemmas 01ZO and 07RP)' (lines 1824-1829)

proof.text: Set R to the chosen stage algebra and c to its inclusion into the completion. Define k by the two projections: Y0 to Y and Y0 to Spec(A/I) followed by Spec(p composed with c). The completion projection composed with A to the completion is the quotient map, so these projections satisfy the pullback condition. Pasting fibre squares identifies W restricted along k with the closed fibre of the completed cover, hence V by step 2.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finiteEtale_completion_stage {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f] (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))) : ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : Algebra A R), Algebra.FinitePresentation A R ∧ ∃ (c : R →ₐ[A] AdicCompletion I A) (W : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R))))) (k : pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R)))), k ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ∧ k ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ I).toRingHom.comp c.toRingHom)) ∧ Nonempty (Over.mk (pullback.snd W.hom k) ≅ Over.mk V.hom)
